summary: KNOREX Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of a shareholder requisition for an EGM regarding board composition and the resignation of two Non-Executive Independent Directors, Jayant Kadambi and Gordon Kwok Wai Lam, effective 3 July 2026 after a 30-day notice period. The resignations may be accelerated by mutual agreement. The company is reviewing the requisition and will convene the EGM. The event is a forced board departure triggered by activist shareholder pressure. Watch for further board changes, potential strategic shift, or settlement ahead of the EGM.
